label.purpose: Controls, statuses, field labels, and ledger headers.

evidence.purpose: Source, exact diffs, selectors, revisions, offsets, and timestamps.

shadows.name: preview-containment
shadows.purpose: Barely lifts the rendered artifact from the cool canvas.

shadows.name: mapped-selection
shadows.purpose: Binds selected evidence to the active issue or mapped source region.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disables transitions, animation, and smooth scrolling when requested.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The current workflow-advancing action, led by Scan.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 32px; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #0b5ed7); border-radius: 5px; background: var(--accent, #0b5ed7); padding: 6px 10px; color: #fff; font: 720 12px/1.35 Inter, Aptos, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #084eb5); border-color: var(--accent-hover, #084eb5); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #0b5ed7); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: A reversible or supporting command such as Undo, Import, or Reject.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 32px; border: 1px solid #b7c1ce; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--surface, #fff); padding: 6px 10px; color: var(--ink, #111827); font: 620 12px/1.35 Inter, Aptos, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f0f4fa; border-color: #9eabbc; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #0b5ed7); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: var(--selected, #eef4ff); }

components.name: Context Field
components.description: Collects the human meaning required for a contextual repair.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 4px; color: var(--ink, #111827); font: 700 11px/1.35 Inter, Aptos, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid #aab5c3; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--surface, #fff); padding: 7px 8px; color: var(--ink, #111827); font: 400 12px/1.45 Inter, Aptos, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #8995a5; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #0b5ed7); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ledger Tabs
components.description: Flush source or preview-state switching without card-like separation.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; background: var(--surface, #fff); } .ds-tabs button { min-height: 30px; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; padding: 5px 10px; color: var(--muted, #526072); font: 620 12px/1.35 Inter, Aptos, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tabs button:hover { background: #f0f4fa; } .ds-tabs button[aria-selected="true"] { border-bottom-color: var(--accent, #0b5ed7); background: var(--selected, #eef4ff); color: var(--accent, #0b5ed7); font-weight: 750; } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #0b5ed7); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Proposal Status
components.description: Declares that a rendered result is proposed and working source is unchanged.
components.css: .ds-status-proposal { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid #ebcf9e; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--proposal-bg, #fff4df); padding: 4px 7px; color: var(--proposal, #9f4f00); font: 700 11px/1.35 Inter, Aptos, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status-proposal:hover { border-color: #d8ae66; } .ds-status-proposal:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #0b5ed7); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Verified Status
components.description: Records successful verification, restoration, or healthy connectivity.
components.css: .ds-status-verified { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid #bfe3d2; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--verified-bg, #e8f7f0); padding: 4px 7px; color: var(--verified, #087a50); font: 700 11px/1.35 Inter, Aptos, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status-verified > span { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--verified, #087a50); } .ds-status-verified:hover { border-color: #91cdb2; } .ds-status-verified:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #0b5ed7); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Inspection Row
components.description: The signature synchronized record for severity, rule, action, and source mapping.
components.css: .ds-inspection-row { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #e6eaf0; background: var(--surface, #fff); padding: 7px 11px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 68px minmax(76px, .6fr) minmax(120px, 1.4fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 8px; text-align: left; color: var(--ink, #111827); cursor: pointer; } .ds-inspection-row:hover, .ds-inspection-row:focus-visible { background: var(--selected, #eef4ff); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent, #0b5ed7); outline: none; } .ds-inspection-row:active { background: #e2ecff; } .ds-inspection-row strong { font: 700 12px/1.3 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-inspection-row > span:not(.ds-impact) { overflow: hidden; color: var(--muted, #526072); font: 400 11.5px/1.35 Inter, Aptos, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-impact { justify-self: start; border-radius: 4px; background: #fff0df; padding: 3px 5px; color: #9a4b00; font: 820 8.5px/1.2 Inter, Aptos, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .035em; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.overview:
Curbcut is a cool-white, ruled developer workspace where source, rendered target, factual evidence, and an exact patch read as one inspection record. The system is compact, restrained, and operational: near-black ink carries facts, cobalt marks action and focus, amber separates proposals from mutations, emerald records verification, and red communicates severity or failure.

The visual world refuses the scanner-dashboard default. It uses panes, rows, footers, and ledgers instead of card grids, scores, charts, or theatrical security chrome. Human judgment remains visible in the sequence from evidence to proposed meaning to exact diff, apply, verification, and undo.
keyCharacteristics: Cool white ruled panes with almost no decorative surface treatment.
Dense system sans for operation and monospace for source, evidence, revisions, and diffs.
Cobalt action, amber proposal, emerald verification, and restrained severity red.
One synchronized workspace record rather than a collection of dashboard widgets.
Text and structure always accompany color-coded state.

rules.name: The State-Is-Meaning Rule
rules.body: Cobalt means action or focus, amber means proposed and unapplied, emerald means verified or healthy, and red means severity or failure; never swap these roles for variety.

rules.name: The Redundancy Rule
rules.body: Every colored state also carries explicit text, structure, or an icon so color is never the only evidence.

rules.name: The Evidence Voice Rule
rules.body: Use monospace only where exact characters, offsets, selectors, revisions, or machine evidence matter.

rules.name: The One Record Rule
rules.body: Source location, rendered target, axe evidence, proposal, diff, and verification must stay visibly mappable through shared selection and aligned pane state.

rules.name: The Flat-Ledger Rule
rules.body: Surfaces remain flat at rest; use rules and tonal fields before shadow.

rules.name: The Joined-Surface Rule
rules.body: Do not round each pane, row, or diff half into an independent card; shared borders should make related evidence feel physically connected.

dos: Do keep source, preview, evidence, and timeline in one ruled workspace.
Do make Scan the leading action and keep approval visually distinct from Apply.
Do label proposed content as unapplied and verified content as verified or restored.
Do preserve exact source, selector, diff, revision, and timestamp text in monospace.
Do keep keyboard focus conspicuous and provide redundant state text.
donts: Don't turn the workspace into a scanner dashboard of scores, charts, or floating cards.
Don't use gradients, neon security styling, glass effects, or a chatbot panel.
Don't imply WCAG compliance from axe results or invent synthetic scores.
Don't use amber, emerald, or red as decorative accents outside their semantic states.
Don't separate a proposal from its exact diff, approval state, and rendered result.
